name: @ohmstead/mcp
description: MCP server that lets AI assistants read and edit Ohmstead projects and the Codex

scripts.npm:prep: npm run build && mkdir -p npm/dist && cp dist/ohmstead-mcp.mjs dist/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md npm/dist/ && node -e "const v=require('./npm/package.json').version,s=require('./npm/server.json');if(s.version!==v||s.packages[0].version!==v)throw new Error('npm/server.json version must match npm/package.json ('+v+')')" && cd npm && npm pack --dry-run
